buildCommand: cd ../.. && pnpm exec turbo run build --filter=investors-and-founders-web

rewrites.comment: Crawlers get server-rendered HTML: the SPA's index.html is 219 characters and returns the same <title> for all ~318,000 URLs, which is invisible to every crawler that does not execute JavaScript — including most AI crawlers.

Anonymous directory reads. Same-origin in production for the same reason as the dev proxy: no CORS, and the browser never learns the API host. Requires the auth-gateway's public read allow-list to be deployed.
Sitemap index. Sections are separate files because the directory is past the 50,000-URL-per-file limit.
The index's child sitemaps — core, places, and the paged investor/company sections.
SPA fallback — every directory route is client-rendered.
